name: tight-70s-warmer
description: Warmer pass of tight-70s-warm: same de-harshed Neve (mid 0 / air 0) + dbx 160, but the Studer A800 is pushed DARKER — 30 IPS (measured -517 centroid vs 15 IPS) and repro_hf_eq rolled 3.5 -> 2.5 to soften the playback-head top. Pair with a punch step whose HIGH band is softened (gain +0.5 -> 0, transient +0.4 -> +0.2) so cymbal/hat attacks aren't sharpened. Built 2026-05-31.
intended_for: the measured-balanced bus re-punched with a softened high band (bus_70s_punched_warm.wav) — when tight-70s-warm still read a touch bright
notes: Tape darkened via IPS + repro_hf_eq, NOT by re-cutting the Neve mid. If still bright, drop repro_hf_eq toward 1.5 (measured -1364 at 0) or reduce the dbx drive (it opens the top).
